claims.claim_text: Owned architecture for a policy-gated agent execution surface powering governed enterprise AI workflows across L0 route-policy dispatch and runtime proof bundle lineage.
Directed CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization through partner-supported deal cycles and usage-based forecasting.
Instituted evaluation gates and telemetry-driven rollback controls that delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows.
Standardized the AI systems lifecycle so client deployments move lab to production in three weeks, down from six months, through managed workflow orchestration.
Engineered distributed cloud execution infrastructure spanning cloud data/runtime integration patterns across Databricks, vector services, and API gateways.
Converted bespoke delivery into reusable platform IP while the engineering team scaled from 8 to 28 to support platform commercialization.
